verses.1: So said Jehovah: “For three sins of Moab, and for four other sins, I will not restore him to life. He will be burned at the stake by King Adam.”
verses.2: And I sent fire into Moab. The sheep were eaten by the flames. They died in Moab, in pain and sorrow.
verses.3: And I realized that her judgment was based on her own feelings, and all her words were spoken along with hers. Then Jehovah said:
verses.4: So said the LORD: “For three sins of the Jews, I will not restore them to their position. They did not keep the laws and commandments of the LORD. They turned away from the path their ancestors had followed.”
verses.5: And I sent fire into Judah, and the walls of Jerusalem were destroyed.
verses.6: So said Jehovah: “For the three sins of Israel, I will not restore them to their former status with gold and silver. Nor will I forgive them for their wickedness.”
verses.7: They are carried on the shoulders of those who are poor and in need. They walk along the path of those who are humble. Both man and his father go there, in order to defile the name of my holiness.
verses.8: And on the utensils used for worship, they will drink wine. They will also eat food that is offered to their gods.
verses.9: And I have defeated their words. Their words were like high trees; they stood tall and strong. But I will destroy them from above, and their roots will be destroyed from below.
verses.10: And I have brought you up from the land of Egypt. I will lead you across the sea for forty years, so that you may possess the land of the Amorites.
verses.11: And I will make from among your children prophets and from among your chosen ones priests. But these are not the children of Israel, says the LORD.
verses.12: And they spat on the prophets. They ordered them not to be revealed.
verses.13: Look, I will break you down, just as the wheel that is filled with sand is broken apart.
verses.14: And Manos died from weakness and strength; he could no longer exert his power. His spirit could not be subdued by anyone.
verses.15: And he who tries to climb the ladder will not be able to stand on it. His feet will not be able to support him. And the rider on the horse will not be able to ride it. His soul will not be able to endure it.
verses.16: And his heart will be filled with hatred. On that day, Jehovah will say: “Nay!”
